provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Original guide sources remain in its metadata.

nameChecks.en: Sturdy Little Brother of the Middle
Stern Little Brother of the Middle

nameChecks.ja: 俺のヘアクーポォオオオン！！！

guideAlias.note: The guide uses an alternate Japanese label for the shared Middle tattoo effect; the matching game entry is 怨恨の刺青 (9009601).

lead.text: Choose which attacks to take and when to deal damage. Prepare in earlier Waves, then concentrate strong Blunt skills during Test of the Big Brother.

priorities.0.text: Keep at least one ally besides Ishmael alive, and let Ishmael take dangerous single-target attacks.

priorities.1.text: Build SP and E.G.O resources in the first 2 Waves, saving your main units' strong Blunt skills.

priorities.2.text: During Test of the Big Brother, Ricardo takes triple damage. Use this opening to Stagger him and reach 50% HP.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Even E.G.O cannot win the Clashes

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Ricardo's high Offense Level makes his Clashes stronger than the listed rolls suggest. Consider directing strong single-target attacks at Ishmael while Blunt attackers deal unopposed damage.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: The hair-coupon area attack wipes out your team

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: First aim to Stagger him during the Test before it arrives. If you cannot, prepare Blunt/Wrath resistance and Protection. Reducing HP damage does not remove the Stagger Threshold increase, so Guard alone may not keep you safe.

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Her survival condition applies only in 5-30 and requires another ally to remain alive. It cannot prevent an area attack from defeating everyone together. It does not support a plan where Ishmael survives alone indefinitely.

units.0.notes.0.text: HP, Level, and other values appear as ??? in-game. HP, Defense Level, and skill levels are based on measurements; skill levels are estimates.

units.0.notes.1.text: Victory triggers at the end of the turn when he first reaches 50% HP. You do not need to reduce him to 0 HP.

units.0.notes.2.text: Victory also triggers at the end of turn 9 of Wave 3, but this requires preparing to survive his area attacks.

units.0.notes.3.text: Stagger does not skip his action pattern. Use it as time to recover.

units.1.name.text: Sturdy Little Brother of the Middle

units.1.notes.0.text: Appear in the first 2 Waves and as Ricardo's allies. Weak to Blunt.

units.1.notes.1.text: Defeating them buffs the remaining Middle members, but leaving them alive to keep inflicting Paralyze and Coin debuffs is also dangerous.

units.2.name.text: Stern Little Brother of the Middle

units.2.notes.0.text: Appear in the first 2 Waves and as Ricardo's allies. Weak to Blunt.

units.2.notes.1.text: Defeating them buffs the remaining Middle members, but leaving them alive to keep inflicting Paralyze and Coin debuffs is also dangerous.

phases.0.title.text: Build SP and save skills for the final Wave

phases.0.steps.0.text: Win manageable Clashes to build your main units' SP and the necessary E.G.O resources. The EX condition is simply clearing the stage, so there is no need to rush.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Against difficult attacks, unopposed attacks aimed at a Defense slot can Stagger the enemy before it acts. Avoid carrying Paralyze or Plus Coin Drop into next turn.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Save strong Blunt skills at the end of Wave 2. Enter Wave 3 with HP remaining on allies besides Ishmael.

phases.1.title.text: Stop the adds and protect your main units

phases.1.steps.0.text: Let Ishmael take Ricardo's strong attacks. While another ally is alive, her HP cannot fall below 1, but she can still suffer Stagger and statuses.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Do not redirect attacks already aimed at Ishmael onto another main unit unnecessarily. For attacks that can be redirected, check Speed and targeting arrows.

phases.1.steps.2.text: The adds use strong attacks next turn. Stagger or defeat them with spare slots or area attacks, saving strong skills against Ricardo for the Test.

phases.2.title.text: Wait for Test of the Big Brother, then concentrate damage

phases.2.steps.0.text: During the Test, Ricardo takes triple skill damage. Use multi-Coin Blunt skills to reach his Stagger Threshold.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Offset his Evade with another Sinner's Defense Skill so your main attackers can land their hits. Offsetting does not cancel the Test gained at Combat Start.

phases.2.steps.2.text: The Offense Level gap means you need not force everyone into losing Clashes. Let a durable Sinner take attacks while your other main units attack unopposed.

phases.2.steps.3.text: Stagger removes the Test. Choose subsequent skills based on his Stagger state and distance from 50% HP, as well as the remaining Test stacks.

phases.3.steps.0.text: When another Evade grants the Test, use it as a fresh damage opening. Focus strong Blunt skills to reach 50% HP.

phases.3.steps.1.text: When MY HAIR COUPOOOOOOOOOOONS!!! appears, its displayed 20–28 is not the full Clash calculation. Account for the Offense Level gap and buffs based on the target's SP.

phases.3.steps.2.text: For a longer survival strategy, keep someone besides Ishmael resistant to Blunt and Wrath, with ongoing Protection and healing. With a normal team, try ending the fight quickly first.

skills.0.effects.0.text: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Deal 3 additional Blunt damage.

skills.0.response.text: Despite a displayed range of 3–9, its Offense Level is high. Check predictions and choose between winning E.G.O, Evade, or having Ishmael take it.

skills.1.effects.0.text: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Deal 5 additional Blunt damage.

skills.1.effects.1.text: Ⅲ：[On Hit] Inflict 3 Paralyze next turn.

skills.1.response.text: Keep next-turn Paralyze off your main attackers. If you cannot stop it with a Clash, choose who will take the hit.

skills.2.effects.0.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Reduce the target's SP by 5.

skills.2.response.text: Attacking Ricardo also triggers his Counter. Avoid weak attacks from fragile Sinners before the Test, and check who receives the Counter.

skills.3.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Grant all enemies 1 Attack Power Up. Inflict 2 Attack Power Down on the 2 Sinners with the lowest SP.

skills.3.response.text: Clashing cannot cancel these Combat Start buffs and debuffs. Check predictions to see whether your main units' power has fallen.

skills.4.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Gain 2 Test of the Big Brother. Gain 5 Bind next turn.

skills.4.response.text: Offset the Evade with a separate Defense slot, then concentrate Blunt skills. The Test applies at Combat Start and remains after offsetting.

skills.5.effects.0.text: If the target's SP is below 0, gain +3 Coin Power.

skills.5.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Heal 10 own SP; inflict 2 Bind and 2 Attack Power Down on the target next turn.

skills.5.effects.2.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Reduce the target's SP by 20.

skills.5.response.text: A powerful single-target attack. Letting Ishmael take it while other main units attack is a useful alternative to forcing a losing Clash.

skills.6.response.text: The summon is not an [On Hit] effect. Plan for more Little Brothers next turn even if you stop this attack.

skills.7.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Gain 2 Test of the Big Brother. Gain 5 Bind and 5 Damage Up next turn.

skills.7.response.text: Offset with a Defense Skill before attacking. The area attack is approaching, so aim for Stagger or 50% HP now.

skills.8.effects.0.text: If the main target's SP is below 0, gain +5 Final Power.

skills.8.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by 30 and inflict 1 Paralyze next turn.

skills.8.response.text: The Offense Level gap makes this especially powerful. Aim to Stagger him before it arrives. Surviving it requires Blunt/Wrath resistance or Protection; Ishmael alone cannot protect everyone.

skills.9.effects.0.text: Ⅰ：[Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze next turn.

skills.9.response.text: Prevent Paralyze from weakening next turn's Clashes. Also a manageable early Clash for building SP.

skills.10.effects.0.text: [Clash Lose] Gain 1 Damage Up next turn.

skills.10.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bind next turn.

skills.10.effects.2.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Deal additional fixed damage equal to the number of allied Middle members defeated this Wave.

skills.10.response.text: Check next turn's buffs even after winning. More defeated Little Brothers also means more fixed damage.

skills.11.effects.0.text: Ⅰ：[Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Attack Power Down next turn.

skills.11.effects.1.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Paralyze next turn.

skills.11.response.text: Stop it with a strong skill or Stagger the enemy before it acts. Avoid forcing a weak skill into the Clash and taking its debuffs.

skills.12.effects.0.text: [Turn End] If Shield remains, gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.

skills.12.response.text: Besides stopping Attack Skills, you can target its Defense slot to Stagger or defeat it.

skills.13.effects.0.text: [Clash Lose] Gain 1 Damage Up next turn.

skills.13.effects.1.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Paralyze next turn. [Tails Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by 8.

skills.13.response.text: Its negative Coins roll higher more often at low SP. Choose its opponent based on enemy SP and current predictions.

skills.14.effects.0.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by 30, deal 20 fixed damage, and inflict 3 Paralyze next turn.

skills.14.response.text: Do not hit a Countering enemy with a fragile main attacker. Consider Staggering or defeating it before it attacks, or letting Ishmael take the Counter.

skills.15.effects.0.text: Ⅰ：[Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze next turn.

skills.15.response.text: Prevent Paralyze from weakening next turn's Clashes. Also a manageable early Clash for building SP.

skills.16.effects.0.text: [Clash Lose] Gain 1 Damage Up next turn.

skills.16.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Damage Down next turn.

skills.16.effects.2.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Deal additional fixed damage equal to the number of allied Middle members defeated this Wave.

skills.16.response.text: Check next turn's buffs even after winning. More defeated Little Brothers also means more fixed damage.

skills.17.effects.0.text: Ⅰ：[Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Plus Coin Drop next turn.

skills.17.effects.1.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 1 Plus Coin Drop next turn.

skills.17.response.text: Stop it with a strong skill or Stagger the enemy before it acts. Avoid forcing a weak skill into the Clash and taking its debuffs.

skills.18.effects.0.text: [Turn End] If Shield remains, gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.

skills.18.response.text: Besides stopping Attack Skills, you can target its Defense slot to Stagger or defeat it.

skills.19.effects.0.text: [Clash Lose] Gain 1 Damage Up next turn.

skills.19.effects.1.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Paralyze next turn. [Tails Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by 8.

skills.19.response.text: Its negative Coins roll higher more often at low SP. Choose its opponent based on enemy SP and current predictions.

skills.20.effects.0.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by 30, deal 20 fixed damage, and inflict 3 Paralyze next turn.

skills.20.response.text: Do not hit a Countering enemy with a fragile main attacker. Consider Staggering or defeating it before it attacks, or letting Ishmael take the Counter.

passives.0.condition.text: Whenever an allied Middle member is defeated

passives.0.effect.text: Gain 1 Offense Level Up for the rest of the battle, up to 5.

passives.0.response.text: Defeating Little Brothers also strengthens Ricardo. Follow add cleanup with focused damage during the Test.

passives.1.effect.text: Heal 10 SP for all enemies, including this unit.

passives.1.response.text: A longer fight lets the enemy maintain high SP. Aim for Stagger and Blunt damage rather than trying to break them through Clashes alone.

passives.2.condition.text: An allied Middle member is defeated

passives.2.effect.text: Gain 1 Plus Coin Boost next turn, up to 2.

passives.2.response.text: The turn after defeating a Little Brother is stronger than usual. Recheck predictions.

passives.3.condition.text: A skill attacking Ricardo deals less than 12 damage

passives.3.response.text: Scattering weak attacks costs SP. Build your plan around strong Blunt attacks during the Test.

passives.4.effect.text: At the next Turn Start, remove Panic and reset SP to 0.

passives.4.response.text: Do not assume SP loss alone will keep him disabled for long.

passives.5.effect.text: Gain 6 Defense Level Down next turn.

passives.5.response.text: Winning manageable Clashes still helps, but do not force extra losing Clashes just to chase this effect.

passives.6.condition.text: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type

passives.6.effect.text: Panic Type stays unchanged; apply the effects intended for enemies without SP instead.

passives.6.response.text: Do not base the strategy on changing Panic Type.

passives.7.condition.text: Whenever an allied Middle member is defeated

passives.7.effect.text: Gain 1 Offense Level Up for the rest of the battle, up to 5.

passives.7.response.text: Check the remaining Little Brothers' attacks too.

passives.8.effect.text: Gain 1 Minus Coin Boost next turn, up to twice per turn.

passives.8.response.text: Negative-Coin Vengeance becomes dangerous when low SP and buffs combine.

passives.9.condition.text: An allied Middle member is defeated

passives.9.effect.text: Gain 1 Plus Coin Boost next turn.

passives.9.response.text: Fewer enemies does not necessarily mean weaker Clashes.

passives.10.condition.text: Whenever an allied Middle member is defeated

passives.10.effect.text: Gain 1 Offense Level Up for the rest of the battle, up to 5.

passives.10.response.text: Check the remaining Little Brothers' attacks too.

passives.11.effect.text: Gain 1 Minus Coin Boost next turn, up to twice per turn.

passives.11.response.text: Negative-Coin Vengeance becomes dangerous when low SP and buffs combine.

passives.12.condition.text: An allied Middle member is defeated

passives.12.effect.text: Gain 1 Plus Coin Boost next turn.

passives.12.response.text: Fewer enemies does not necessarily mean weaker Clashes.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Take triple skill damage and triple Stagger Threshold damage from Tremor Burst. Decrease by 1 at Turn End. Removed on Stagger. If it expires without Stagger, gain 5 Damage Up next turn.

mechanics.0.response.text: Concentrate strong Blunt skills during this window. After Stagger removes it, stop calculating damage with the triple multiplier.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Ishmael starts combat at -25 SP. At Turn Start, if her SP is below 0, gain 3 Attack Power Up.

mechanics.1.response.text: Negative SP lowers Heads odds on Plus Coins. Do not assign too many Clashes to her based only on the power buff.

mechanics.2.effect.text: While another ally is alive, Ishmael's HP cannot fall below 1. She cannot retreat. This does not protect her if an area attack defeats her together with all remaining allies.

mechanics.2.response.text: Always protect at least one survivor besides Ishmael. This condition does not carry into later fights such as Ahab.

warnings.0.text: Attacking Ricardo triggers his Counter. Avoiding his Clashes does not guarantee fragile attackers can deal damage safely.

warnings.1.text: Offsetting Evade does not remove Combat Start buffs. You can still use Test of the Big Brother.

warnings.2.text: Victory triggers at 50% HP or at the end of turn 9 of Wave 3. A survival strategy is possible, but waiting without suitable Protection, healing, and resistances is dangerous.

warnings.3.text: This guide is separate from Ricardo's Reflectrial. Do not apply Ishmael's survival condition here to other content.

preparation.0.text: Aim for the recommended Level 40, starting with strong Blunt Identities. Check their skills and passives through Uptie III too.

preparation.1.text: Ishmael is mandatory. Provided another ally survives, she can take attacks even if underleveled.

preparation.2.text: Prioritize Blunt resistance and check Wrath/Envy Sin resistances too, including resistance changes after using E.G.O.

preparation.3.text: If few Sinners are trained, you can deploy 4–5 and gain extra action slots in deployment order. Keep your defender and Blunt damage rather than removing units indiscriminately.

roles.0.reason.text: Secure Speed and action slots to redirect attacks away from main attackers while also keeping other allies alive.

roles.1.name.text: Blunt attacker for the Test window

roles.1.reason.text: Save high-power multi-Coin skills for this opening. If borrowing Support, choose an Identity with suitable Blunt damage and resistances.

roles.2.reason.text: Help main attackers land their hits, using Attack Power Down or Protection to limit damage when needed.
